title: Alma Pleads for Abinadi
summary: After Abinadi finishes speaking, the king commands the priests to take him and put him to death. Alma pleads for Abinadi to be allowed to depart in peace. The king causes Alma to be cast out and sends servants after him to slay him.

The king becomes more angry, causes Alma to be cast out, and sends servants after him to slay him.
